propositions: Extract coupled identity transition rules (bind, confirm, unbind, reverse cleanup, numeric-ID re-key) from BindingStore into a new BindingLifecycle slice while preserving all existing behaviors exactly and retaining the public facade as coordination owner.
Every valid bind/confirm/unbind transition must leave at most one forward entry and one matching reverse entry, verified by reloading both indexes from disk.
bind_confirm must remain last-writer-wins on the forward entry and pop exactly one differing old reverse key with no sweep, no ambiguity detection, and no abort.
Stale reverse entries are removed only in four existing permitted cases: rebind, unbind, re-key, and retire; any other removal is forbidden.
Numeric-ID re-key moves issues by updating jira_key, resetting absent_404_count, stamping updated_at, and swapping reverse keys without retiring the binding.

Legacy records without numeric IDs retain current behavior and all existing facade signatures, including note_absent_or_rekey as a coordinator that falls through to absence policy only when re-key declines.
